text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, the menu looks fine like 
this~... Ingredients ordered... and done.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, the menu sign! Oh dear, oh dear. I 
almost forgot about it~.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Let's see, ink and washi paper, check...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Alright. Looks like you noticed it 
properly this time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Yukoma Ryokan. I spotted the head 
landlady watching over the young landlady. 
She deliberately chose not to intervene――
choice_data_list: A hands-off approach to education, is it?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's the type who grows best when 
left to her own devices.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I've had my fair share of 
landlady training. It's about time I start 
noticing these things on my own.
choice_data_list:
Guess all we can do is have faith and 
wait!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing grand. It's just boorish to 
keep interfering forever.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, guess I'll head off to my 
next job.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
The height of the flower arrangement is... 
yeah, good. No ominous meanings in the 
language of flowers, either.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...True, it's nice and all, but...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
If you trim the "assistant" part just a 
bit, wouldn't the balance be much 
better...?

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's go put up the decorations!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So you're leaving. Just to 
become a decoration...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...No, hold it in, Takeshi. Pointing it 
out should only be the very, very last 
resort.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I know she'll notice... She has to 
notice...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Looking at it like this, this part 
feels kind of long...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, let's do this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I saw the landlady again... she 
looked somewhat exhausted...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Nothing, it's no big deal. ...Hey, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Even when ya know they'll be fine, 
watchin' over 'em... kinda makes ya tense 
up, don't it?
choice_data_list: ...Would you like to take a break?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I see. This situation is a lot like 
a race.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text: Nah, never mind. It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Just like before, all we can do now is 
believe and watch over them.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
A break... You're right. Let's take a 
break before she catches on.
choice_data_list:
Could this be about the young 
proprietress?

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I'm just worrying on my own for no reason. 
Ugh, give me a break, seriously.
